title: SynthFest UK 2026
location: The Octagon Centre, Clarkson Street, Sheffield S10 2TQ
notes:
The UK's biggest gathering of synthesizers, run by *Sound On Sound* with Sensoria. Over 60 exhibitors, from boutique Eurorack builders to the major keyboard brands, plus free seminars and demos with a ticket.

[SynthFest UK](https://www.synthfest.co.uk/)

title: SUPERBOOTH27
notes:
Three days of electronic musical instruments at FEZ-Berlin — the biggest gathering for modular synthesizers, with talks, demos, concerts and DJ sets. Tickets go on sale in December.

Nearest station is S-Bhf. Wuhlheide, then a 15–20 minute walk through the park.

[superbooth.com](https://www.superbooth.com/en/)
